tokens.name: brand-witcha-blue
tokens.usage: CONFIRMED. The signature colour people remember the brand by: tins, packaging fields, hero blocks, large web panels. Never a text colour and never the logo colour. Text on it: brand-deep-blue (4.9:1). Never white text on it (1.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-aqua-light
tokens.usage: Working reference. Soft panel and section background; brand-deep-blue text on it is 6.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-teal-soft
tokens.usage: Working reference. Illustration and decorative use only; fails as text.

tokens.name: brand-blue-teal
tokens.usage: Working reference. Illustration and decorative use only; 2.9:1 on ivory, so never body text.

tokens.name: brand-blue-mid
tokens.usage: Working reference. Secondary text at 24px and above only (4.45:1 on ivory, 3.0:1 on Witcha blue); links on ivory need an underline.

tokens.name: brand-deep-blue
tokens.usage: CONFIRMED logo colour. Main text, headings, buttons, lines. 7.3:1 on ivory, 4.9:1 on Witcha blue, 7.8:1 with white text on it.

tokens.name: brand-ivory
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Warm page background and information panels; reversed logo colour on deep blue.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Logo gold. Printed as gold foil; on screen a stand-in. Rules in the reversed logo, thin decorative lines. Never text: 2.5:1 on ivory, 1.7:1 on Witcha blue.

tokens.name: brand-blush
tokens.usage: PROPOSED accent, under 10% of a layout: small details and illustration. Deep blue text on it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: brand-sage
tokens.usage: PROPOSED accent, under 10%: botanical details in illustration. Not a text background for small text (3.6:1 with deep blue).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text on brand-deep-blue buttons; white logo version on photography.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Default website page background.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Signature blocks: hero, product sections, footer band.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet panels: product facts, FAQs, shipping notes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: All body text and headings on surface-page, surface-brand and surface-soft.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Large secondary text only (24px+). For small secondary text use text-primary at a smaller size.

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on brand-deep-blue (7.3:1).

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button background (Add to cart, Shop). Label: white.

tokens.name: action-primary-text
tokens.usage: Label on action-primary (7.8:1).

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders on ivory. Decorative only, not a control border.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, focus rings (meets 3:1).

families.display: "Libre Caslon Display", "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, serif
families.serif: "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline only. Drop to 44px on mobile.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles and product names. 34px on mobile.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.sample: How to make it at home

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two grams, a splash of hot water, a quick froth.
styles.usage: All running text. PROPOSED face: Jost.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, taste-role labels, buttons in capitals. Always set in capitals.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: The tagline wherever it appears near the logo. Never locked into the logo.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space between blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between page sections on desktop (40px on mobile).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero padding and generous breathing room around the logo.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default: panels, images, buttons. The brand is square and calm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small chips only.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: The arch motif: top two corners only (border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0) on a frame at least as tall as it is wide. Image frames and character art windows.
